premise: I sank $158,000 of my 401(k) from 29 years as a cafeteria manager into a 50% share of a mortuary with my sister-in-law, who promised free pre-need plans for my church seniors, then she forged a shareholder resolution and sold the business to a regional chain for $1.1 million, mailing me a $5,000 'casket' check; I proved the resolution was backdated with email metadata, voided the sale, and now run 'Rigor of Deceit Mortuary,' where she waxes hearses in a smock that says 'Buried My Trust' and every memorial folder prints the fraud docket.
